name: Ray of Light (3pp)
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level cleric/oracle 0, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A single ray of bright golden light flies from your fingertips toward a designated target. With a successful ranged touch attack, any creature that is powerless or suffers any other type of penalty in sunlight – living or undead – is shaken for 1 round.
